q2_gaps: deictic locative adverbs ("here", "there") — the instruction set makes deictic TIMES speech-anchored bare constants but says nothing about deictic places, and the oblique-object rule only covers article/mass/proper-name NPs, so a bare `here` constant is by analogy only
the "be to" scheduled/arranged construction ("is to be held") — its scheduling and mild obligation force has no operator; only the futurate rule is available

passive light verbs over an event noun ("the meeting is to be held") — the light-verb rule names only occurred/happened/took place, leaving it undecided whether "be held" reifies a separate hold event or lets the event-noun witness carry the time and place itself
notes: Agentless passive correctly omits the Agent, Patient is right for a verb that brings a scheduled occurrence about, and Future is licensed by the lexically future adjunct "tomorrow" (no TODAY supplied, so the deictic correctly stays a bare constant with no calendar atoms).
